slides.title: 5 Tips for Faster Image Rendering
slides.tip1: Use the batch endpoint to render multiple images in a single request, reducing network overhead.
slides.tip2: Pre-warm your template cache by hitting each endpoint once after deploy.
slides.tip3: Store brand colors in environment variables to keep your defaults.json DRY.
slides.tip4: Use SVG-compatible Unicode characters instead of HTML entities in all text fields.
slides.tip5: Profile with cargo flamegraph to find bottlenecks in your render pipeline.
